article_body: the single div.atoms[data-component=blocks] of the article

required_fields.公司代號: code in parentheses of the 公司名稱 header line
required_fields.公司名稱: 公司名稱 header line before 說明
required_fields.主旨: 主旨 header line before 說明
required_fields.財務報告期間: 報導期間起訖日期 after 說明, ROC dates

announcement_date: 日期 header line; a date only, not an announcement time

selection.accepted: every MOPS-form article matching the target, in candidate order
selection.no_accepted_with_retryable_review: rate_limited if any review is rate_limited, else temporary_error
